watch.summary: The creator intensely reacts to 100 Thieves completing a 10-2 comeback against LOUD in Valorant, screaming in hype before showing off his team jersey.

beats.what: The creator watches the crucial Valorant round intently, shouting 'Let's go!'
100 Thieves starts securing kills, causing the creator to scream in excitement.
The creator holds his head in disbelief and screams as 100 Thieves secures the round win.
The creator jumps up and briefly leaves the frame celebrating the victory.
The creator returns to his chair, holding up a 100 Thieves jersey while repeating 'Jobs not done'.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Get him out of my face bro!
watch.why: This clip is driven by high-energy esports hype and fandom excitement rather than structured comedy setups. The humor is minimal, relying mostly on the creator's explosive physical reaction and celebratory jersey flex.
